meta.name: Alejox Gaming — Tech Clean edit identity (v2)
source: reference/channel-page.png — brand colours, logo, 20° banner diagonal ONLY (thumbnails stay loud; the video does not copy them)
Direction: MKBHD restraint (small clean sans type, few elements, footage is the star) + Harris Heller / Alpha Gaming functional screen callouts (highlight what to click, nothing decorative)
meta.medium_of_origin: YouTube tech/OBS tutorials, 16:9 long form + 9:16 Shorts
not_copied: No MKBHD or Alpha Gaming assets, fonts or layouts are copied; only their restraint principles
meta.history: v1 (thumbnail/MrBeast: Anton skewed caps, strokes, yellow breakout, frequent punch-ins) REJECTED by the creator 2026-09-29: 'se ve caricatura', 'muchos zooms distraen del contenido'. Archived in history/.

soul.one_line: Small white Geist labels on flat near-black panels, one cyan accent, a 20° grape-to-cyan slash as the only brand flourish, footage untouched.
soul.lineage: Premium tech-review restraint (MKBHD) + streaming-tutorial callouts (Alpha Gaming)
soul.read_distance: laptop and phone; minimum text 26px at 1080px canvas width

colors.name: electric cyan-blue
colors.role: THE accent: highlight boxes, active word, progress, one emphasised word

colors.name: deep grape
colors.role: brand only: the 20° slash, section cards, lower-third tick

banned: yellow in video overlays (yellow lives in thumbnails only)
any accent other than cyan (no red/green marks: checks are cyan, strikes are white 60%)

families.role: brand moments: wordmark, classic subscribe card

families.source: public/fonts/Anton-Regular.ttf (thumbnails only, not loaded in video)

treatment.case: Sentence case everywhere; ONLY meta labels (e.g. 'PASO 2') in caps with +0.14em tracking

space.grid: overlays anchor to the lower-left or upper-left corner; screen callouts anchor to their target
space.margin_pct: one system: 96px at 1920 (5%) left/right for every archetype; top = bottom margin
space.alignment: left-aligned text, never centred in 16:9 (Shorts captions centred)
space.rhythm: one overlay at a time; at least 3s of clean footage between talking-head overlays
space.negative_space: the speaker and the UI being explained are never covered

surface.edges: panels 12px radius at 1080p; the brand slash is the only sharp 20° edge
surface.elevation: flat; a single 1px white-8% hairline on panels over busy footage; no drop shadows
surface.imagery: footage untouched, no push-ins on talking head; screen captures may zoom ONLY to reveal a detail
surface.iconography: Lucide-style line icons, 2px stroke, white or cyan; no emoji
surface.logo: Use src/brand/LogoMark.tsx (inline vector from public/logo/alejox.svg). Optical centring is baked into its viewBox (mark 60% of box, anchor 35% from bbox centre toward area centroid -> ~3.4% above centre). The SVG box must equal the disc box: no padding, borders or offsets.

signatures: Text is small: labels at 3.2% of frame height, section titles at 8% — the footage stays the subject
Every panel carries the brand slash: a 6px-wide grape→cyan bar on its left edge, top cut at 20°
Cyan is the only accent and covers under 2% of the frame
Screen callouts = dim everything outside the target to 45% + 2px cyan rounded highlight box + small step chip; the zoom (if any) is smooth, 1.0→max 1.8, 18 frames, at most once per step
Motion is smooth and short: enter 12 frames (ease-out cubic, 16px slide + fade), exit 8 frames; no overshoot, no shake
Section changes use the 20° diagonal wipe (grape band then cyan band), 14 frames — the only loud moment

weird_move.how: Everything in the kit is orthogonal and quiet EXCEPT the 20° cut: the top of every panel's accent bar, the section wipe, and the lower-third tick. It is the banner's seam, reused as a signature.
weird_move.why: It ties the sober video to the loud thumbnails/banner without importing their cartoon type

archetypes.name: TITLE
archetypes.layout: lower-left panel: meta label ('TUTORIAL · OBS') + one-line title

archetypes.name: LOWER_THIRD
archetypes.layout: logo disc + 'Alejoxgaming' + 'Tutoriales · Tecnología · Streaming', panel with brand slash

archetypes.name: SECTION
archetypes.layout: diagonal wipe → dark frame with '01' + section title left-aligned, 1.5s, wipe out

archetypes.name: KEYWORD
archetypes.use: a key term the viewer must remember (sparingly, max 1 per 30s)
archetypes.layout: small panel lower-left, term in white, optional cyan word

archetypes.name: SPOTLIGHT
archetypes.layout: dim + highlight box + step chip ('PASO 2 · Habilita el servidor WebSocket'), optional smooth zoom

archetypes.name: VALUE
archetypes.use: exact values to copy: port, IP, setting
archetypes.layout: panel with label + JetBrains Mono value, copy icon

archetypes.name: CHECKLIST
archetypes.layout: panel with 2-4 rows, green checks drawing in one by one

archetypes.name: COMPARE
archetypes.use: A vs B (price, free vs pro)
archetypes.layout: two columns in one panel, winner gets a cyan hairline, loser gray with red strike

archetypes.name: OUTRO
archetypes.layout: dark frame, logo disc, 'Gracias por ver' + two end-screen slots as flat panels

motion.easing: Easing.out(Easing.cubic) or spring({damping: 200}) — critically damped, zero overshoot
entrances: stroke draw-on (@remotion/paths) for highlight boxes and checks
motion.motion_blur: CameraMotionBlur only on the section wipe and screen zooms
motion.zoom_budget: talking head: 0 zooms. Screen capture: max 1 zoom per step, only to make something legible

pacing.long_form: the footage carries the video; overlays are sparse and functional
pacing.shorts: captions 2-4 words per chunk, Inter 700, white with the spoken word in cyan, 4-frame rise (no scale pop); jump cuts allowed, zooms not
pacing.shorts_layout: Screen segments use a SPLIT: top ~42% speaker (face-cam crop, edge to edge), bottom ~58% screen crop edge to edge, straight divider with the slash at its left end, captions on the divider. Fallback: full-bleed screen crop over a blurred 40%-dark copy of itself. Never flat black areas.

voice.register: direct, neutral Latin American Spanish (tú), technical and exact
voice.headline_shape: sentence case statements: 'Conecta Deckboard con OBS'

bans: Never condensed, skewed, outlined or shadowed display type
Never a punch-in or zoom on the talking head
Never more than one zoom per screen-capture step
Never overshoot, bounce, shake, or scale-pop entrances
Never ALL CAPS titles (caps only for small meta labels)
Never more than one overlay on screen at once (Shorts: captions + at most one other)
Never cover the speaker's face or the UI element being explained
Never glows, textures, particles, emoji, or gradients except the brand slash
Never full subtitles in 16:9 long form
Never place a chip/label over the UI element being explained
Never an overlay while a burned-in source graphic is on screen
Never flat black/empty areas over ~8% of a Short frame (outro excepted)

tests.test: Cyan covers under 2% of the frame; no yellow pixels from overlays
At most 2 type sizes in one frame
Largest overlay text under 9% of frame height
All video text Geist / Geist Mono (Jost only for brand moments), sentence case (meta labels excepted), no stroke, no shadow, no skew
Every panel has the 20° grape→cyan slash on its left edge
Overlays inside the platform safe area
Zero zooms on talking-head segments; max one zoom per SPOTLIGHT step
Smallest text >= 26px on a 1080px-tall frame (16:9) or 1080px-wide frame (9:16)
Squint test: the footage, not the graphics, is the first thing you see
Logo mark bbox centre within 1.5% of disc diameter horizontally and 2-4% ABOVE disc centre vertically (optical), measured on a rendered still for every archetype showing the disc
Shorts: flat #111/#0E0E12 area <= 8% of the frame (outro excepted)
